annotations.title: Move a whole campaign by N days

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Moves every not-yet-posted piece of a campaign (pinned queue items, booked posts, posts held for review, planned drafts) by `days` (and optional `hours`), each keeping its local time of day in the campaign's time zone. Approvals stay one group; nothing is posted, booked or approved. Posted pieces never move; pieces about to post or whose new time would be past are listed and left. ALWAYS call it with dryRun: true first, show the user old → new times, and apply only after they confirm, with an idempotencyKey. `itemIds` or `label` narrow it. Needs `publish`; Agency plan.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/{id}/shift.)

dryRun.description: true: report what would move, write nothing.

hours.description: Extra hours on top of the days.

idempotencyKey.description: 8–128 letters, digits, . _ : - . Generated when absent and returned as shiftKey.

itemIds.description: Only these pieces (queue item, post, content or campaign item ids).
